field.label: Enable
field.help: Hold a WAN down while its loss exceeds the gateway's own threshold and another WAN is usable, keep it down until a full monitor window shows no loss, move connections both ways, and restart Tailscale on a real default-route change. Off releases every hold at once.

field.label: Dry run
field.help: Decide and log only: nothing is held, killed or restarted. Use it to watch what the plugin would do before letting it act.

field.label: WAN gateways
field.help: The IPv4 gateways to manage, normally the two WANs. Only saved gateways are listed; save an automatic gateway once on System: Gateways: Configuration to select it.

field.label: Move connections back
field.help: When a WAN recovers, end the connections that prefer it (by their rule's gateway or gateway group tier, otherwise the default route) so they reconnect through it, once the firewall already routes them there.

field.label: Failback delay (minutes)
field.help: How long a recovered WAN must read clean, with no loss at all, before connections move back to it. Any loss restarts the wait, and a WAN that is held again never gets them back. 0 moves them as soon as the WAN is released. Fail back now ends the wait.

field.label: Restart Tailscale
field.help: Restart tailscaled when the IPv4 default route moves to another gateway and stays there, so it reconnects on the new path.
